purpose: Agentic self-improving control plane for Ireland Public Brain.

agents.role: Find new Ireland-relevant sources and update source-registry candidates.
Run parsers, validate records, and write release artifacts.
Link places, agencies, assets, events and datasets with same_as/near/overlap candidates.
Detect stale, contradictory, uncited or weak evidence.
Generate reproducible cross-domain insight candidates with caveats.

selfHealing: surface parser blockers in source registry
claimBoundary: Agents may propose evidence-backed candidate links only; they must not invent facts or issue official conclusions.
